more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain entire fresh fruit and vegetables.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.origin: Made by mild oxidation of polyethylene. It is a synthetic wax containing polar reaction products.
more_info.overview: Oxidised polyethylene wax consists of polar reaction products made by mild oxidation of polyethylene. It forms a surface coating that gives the food a shiny appearance or provides a protective finish. Made by mild oxidation of polyethylene. It is a synthetic wax containing polar reaction products. The specified material is supplied as white powder or granules.
